a prefix bearing the meaning asunder or apart

auserkiesen.et: From aus- + erkiesen, from Middle High German erkiesen, from Old High German arkiosan. Compare English choose, Dutch kiezen.

auserlesen.et: From Middle High German ūzerlesen. Equivalent to aus- (“out”) + erlesen (“select, choose”).

s: to rip apart, tear apart, pull apart

aus etwas Kapital schlagen.et: Literally, “to beat capital out of something”.

aus etwas Honig saugen.et: Literally, “to suck honey out of something”.

s: to diverge, to disperse, to part
of a piece; of the same kind
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see aus, einem, Guss.
aus einem Guss.et: Literally, “from one casting”, or more loosely translated as “from one and the same casting (as in, cast iron)”.

auserwählen.et: From Middle High German ūȥerweln. Equivalent to aus- + erwählen.
